Emlyn Hughes' Arcade Quiz is a game based on quiz machines found in bars and public houses. The idea is to move through ten mazes of blocks and reach the Win bar on the right of the screen. Be careful though, as the maze scrolls to the left and if your not quick enough you will reach the Lose bar on the left of the screen.

You will encounter different types of blocks that will help or hinder you. These include Question blocks, get it right and you can move on, get it wrong and you have to answer another question meaning you slowly scroll towards the left of the screen. Money can also be collected to help stack up your total at the end of the level. Other blocks include a block that will block you for a certain time and a block that moves you in a random direction.

When you reach the Win bar you enter a bonus game where on a time limit you have to answer as a number of questions based on how many coins you collected. Afterwards you have a choice to either cash in your money or move onto the next level which will cost you money to enter. Along with the main playing area, you can also see how much money you have and any bonuses collected.

197954.overview:
Epyx Action is a compilation of five games:

4x4 Off-Road Racing
California Games
Impossible Mission II
Street Sports Basketball
The Games: Winter Edition

197959.overview:
This game is actually a lot like chess! It’s a games designed to simulate pitched battles in the Ancient world. There is a set of armies available from the earliest times until the fall of the Western Roman Empire, in 475 A.D.

You can design the terrain and/or units, set-up each side’s troops and then it's just on to the battle. You are doing nothing but fighting the battle you created.

There are also some pre-designed scenarios and maps for your enjoyment.

197960.overview:
Welcome to my pro-darts computer program. This game’s really got the atmosphere and tension of professional dart tournaments.

(Mind you get your own beer in and prize money’s down to you.) You need calm nerves and a steady hand to succeed as a pro-darts player.

So best of order, game on (and don’t lose your bottle).

Be lucky,
Eric Bristow

197961.overview:
Escape from Omicron (also known as 3D Escape from Omicron) is your typical maze escape game which was popular in the early 1980s. This one was developed by Andrew Quilley and published by Video Showcase in 1984. The game has two modes, regular view, and 3D view.
The player's task is to find the exit from the maze by pressing the X key in the right place. The player has only 3 attempts and if they fail the game will end with a loss. The game screen is divided into two parts. The upper one places the hero's eye view, while the lower one shows the entire maze with the exit point appearing as you move. The player's location is not shown and must be determined independently based on the 3D view.

197963.overview:
European Soccer Challenge allows you to play as one of fourteen European football teams (including the mighty Wrexham) against another player or the computer. Options include the number of players, your skill level and the team you want to play as.

The match is viewed from above showing a small part of the pitch. The joystick controls the nearest player to the ball and the fire button allows you to shoot or pass. The keyboard is used to select your options on the menu screens.

197965.overview: European Superleague is a managerial soccer simulation which is about an fictional European league featuring eight of the most successful teams (PSV Eindhoven, Glasgow Rangers, Liverpool, Arsenal, Real Madrid, Olympique de Marseilles, AC Milan and Bayern Munich). The player takes control over one of those clubs and is responsible for its athletic and financial success. The player has all the usual options available, including tactics, lineup, transfer market or training. A speciality is the weekly board meeting in which the chairman gives his opinion on the team's current stand. Each team has 20 athletes with abilities which influence their performance during the match (no graphical representation). The game is completely menu-based and the sub-menus are reached through the main menu which has a different graphical or text presentation depending on the used platform.

197975.overview: The name means ‘the game of the goose’ in English, and it’s much like snakes and ladders. Get up to three friends to play (you can’t play it on your own, unless you want to take control of all the players) and roll the dice to progress along the board. Landing on the geese lets you jump some of the squares, although there are some squares that cause you to miss some turns – and don’t land on the skull! Younger players will enjoy the bright colours and pictures.

197977.overview:
Spanish compilation of 5 games:

Chicago's 30
Coliseum
Operation Wolf
Psycho Pigs U.X.B.
Titanic

198458.overview: It's Ranch! Create and animate wild west scenes with a slew of critters, characters, and shapes. Git along and have fun! Ages 5-10.

199613.overview:
Escape From Pulsar 7 is the fourth title in the Mysterious Adventure series of illustrated text adventures by Brian Howarth. It has a science-fiction theme influenced by the hit film "Alien". The player finds themselves trapped alone on a giant space ship. The rest of the crew are dead, killed by a mutated zoo specimen.

The player's goal is ultimately that they must escape the ship in a life pod to avoid being the creature's next meal. Explore the bunks of your comrades to find the tools needed. Only useful items can be taken, so the gameplay is quite linear, with several maze sections.

These games used the Scott Adams adventure engine, and thus also have the same features - a basic 2-word parser, small vocabulary, and brief descriptions. They were similar to other adventures of the time.

200626.overview:
Mort, while following professor Bacteria’s trace, has been kidnapped by the KGB criminal organization (Killers, Gangsters and Bastards). 
Before he dissappeared, he used his shoe phone to call to his partner in adventures, our hero Phil Pi.

Our mission is to enter the secret den of the enemy organization and once there, set Mort free, give professor Bacteria the antidote and together, get back to the T.I.A. headquarters.

Do you dare accept the challenge?

200814.overview: Take on the role of the musketeer Dartagnan and fight a spectacular duel in the camp of Captain Treville's regiment. It's the prelude to a great adventure, the threshold of a mission of the utmost importance, the threshold of a great feat... and all on your Spectrum. A retro-adventure with an 8-bit system.

201189.overview:
The aim of the game is to collect all the keys on the screen avoiding enemies, spikes and platform jumping death falls. Egghead can only progress to the next level once all objects are picked up. The game contains a total of 40 screens. Egghead has only four lives. Time is limited too.

Released on the Crash Magazine issue 73: Presents 9 Covertape.

201552.overview:
Terrorists have hidden venomous snakes inside easter eggs.

Your mission is to smash all the eggs and kill them before some kid gets bitten

202181.overview:
Everest Ascent is a strategy resource management game where the player is the leader of an expedition attempting to climb Mount Everest.

With a limited starting fund of £1000, the player must juggle expenses to hire sherpas, purchase equipment that may be useful in the ascent (tents, ropes, planks), as well as rations to keep everyone fed. Able to set up various base camps on the way up, the progress of the player's expedition may also result in donations being given to the player to help his efforts (which the player can find out about if he pays out for a radio for the expedition). Of course, collecting such donations and gathering new supplies and sherpas will require returning to the village to collect them. Can you keep everyone alive and strong enough to reach the summit?

203034.overview:
You are El Stompo, TV repair thing of some considerable repute. Your job is to fix all TVs on each level through brute force (by stomping on them). The game combines arcade and puzzle elements, requiring players to plan their routes and use different gameplay elements to avoid all kinds of enemies. 

Technically it's implemented using the NIRVANA Engine, which allows the ZX-Spectrum to display full-screen multicolor (combining more colours than normally possible without colour clash).

211201.overview: Two students of the famous Thieves School have failed their exam. The professors have decided to give them one more chance, a delictive tour around the world, in which they will face dangerous situations while they steal valuable objects of any kind. Help them to graduate!

214908.overview:
You have been nominated to defend the parliamentary seat of Pendell and have just 10 days and £5,000 to make it happen.

Choose your manifesto, collect whatever donations you can, Westminster beckons for the bold.

215004.overview:
Remember how those aliens paid Egghead a visit a few years ago leaving his house in such a mess he ad to go around clearing up after them?   Obviously that wasn't "un oeuf", because they're back again and this time they've abducted Egghead's favourite Spectrum games.

Quick witted as ever, our "dairydevil" hero managed to "scramble" aboard one of
the alien rocket ships before it took off for planet Zog and hitched a ride back
with the extra-terrestrials to retrieve his precious software collection. Upon
arriving, Egghead managed to teleport into the underground labyrinth and that
was when his problems really began...

Move Egghead around the screens leaping from platform to platform in search of
the disc containing the computer games. Try not to fall too far as eggs are
delicate, and avoid any green slime you may encounter. On the other hand, the
green bubbles that rise from the slime are not deadly. Numerous items can be
collected along the way to help Egghead in his quest.

Once the computer disc has been located, Egghead needs to acquire some transport back to Earth.

215223.overview:
Earth's destiny lies in the balance. Rumour has it that mad scientists are developing a new weapon so dangerous it makes the a-bomb look like a firecracker. Reliable sources confirms that it's got something to do with Miner Willy's DNA, some radioactive components and a fairly large sausage. Eugene, the most evil being in the galaxy, ain't to happy with people who go out and do evil stuff without letting him in on it, so he has decided to find out what's going on, kill those responsible and possibly destroy the entire universe. 

Well, that's what happens when one writes the plot after the game's all done... But then again, we all know that Manic Miner games don't have to rely on sophisticated plots. It's all about the thrill of jumping up and down... So, take Eugene (That toilet drinking, four eyed antihero from Manic Miner) and guide him through 16 levels of unspeakable 48K glory.

216101.overview: Ed-On is a clone of the arcade game Head On. It's a racing game where the player has to drive his car counter clockwise around a four lane circuit. Once the whole circuit has been completed, the player will move on to the next level. All around the circuit are dots, that show where the player hasn't been. The level is finished when all dots are gone. The player also must avoid the AI controlled cars that race in the opposite direction. If he would crash he loses one life. On the first level there's only one car to rise against, but the numbers increases for every level. Sometimes flags will show up on the circuit. Picking these up will give extra points. The game uses directional keys to jump between lanes, as well as speed up and slow down.

219146.overview: Escape from Devil's Island is a text adventure with some basic graphics for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed by Dave Watson and published by Central Solutions in 1986.

422236.overview:
Earth-3 is dying. We have consumed and devastated our entire planet, as we did before.

And now, this is humans' last attempt to avoid our own extinction.

Planet ZMX-22 could still save us. Known as "Exo-tical", due to its exoplanet status and its particular and dangerous natural characteristics, it contains an inexhaustible source of energy belonging to an ancient extinct civilization.

Many expeditions have tried it before, but today, the last spaceships will leave for Exo-tical and it will certainly be our last chance.

 May God have mercy on us all.

424134.overview: In a dark and hidden place, hidden between imposing mountains and dense forests, lie the secrets of a silent village that pulses with terror. Its people, shrouded in an oppressive mystery, live immersed in the constant fear that has taken over their lives. Every alley, every corner, whispers macabre stories that would shake even the bravest heart.

440450.overview:
Adaptation for ZX Spectrum +3 by Ximo Company "ximoKom".

 This is the first game-book in the legendary Choose Your Own Adventure collection published in Spain by Timun Mas in the eighties, being a reference that fueled the imagination of young people.  Now as a tribute, running on a mythical computer from the same time.

 Keys: O / P : Selection of options SPACE : Choose option.

447099.overview:
You are trapped on the planet EXODRON without power in the batteries of your spaceship, you need the 10 charges to be able to return your spaceship to life and be able to escape from the planet and return home.

You also have to get into the Interspace transmissions computer to enter the destination coordinates for your home planet.

Dodge the enemies and get the keys/cards that give access to different areas so you can achieve your goal.

When you return, keep in mind that time is ticking before taking off and you will have to get to your ship as soon as possible or you will stay on EXODRON forever.

Good luck.

448376.overview:
Nachete “El Intern” is a 22-year-old boy with a brilliant brain, so much so that he was hired by the company “Neurolonk”, a company that worked and experimented with the latest technology in Artificial Intelligence.

One afternoon, when all his colleagues higher in rank than him in the company began to leave, his boss ordered her to go to one of the research rooms to collect his access card.

Nachete couldn't refuse, so, without further delay, he went there. After a few seconds doing a quick view of the room, he found it, on top of a device that had more buttons and gadgets than an airplane. When picking up the card, Nachete had the bad luck to trip over a loose cable and hit all the buttons there.

He doesn't know how or why, he found himself involved in some strange story which includes an evil artificial intelligence called “Rocco's Basilisk” full of hatred for humanity and ready to make people its slaves.

448991.overview:
After the incident 12 years ago, Nachete would no longer call himself “The Intern”, he was “The Boss” of Security at the company “Neurolonk” which he joined as an intern. Many things have happened in all these years, such as losing the great hair he had. If so much work and so much displeasure leaves you with poor hair...

The fact is that a strange virus threatens the company he works for, and as its Head of Security he has to remove it.

When trying to find out where the attack came from, Nachete realized that it was not from any organization on planet Earth, since the source code and the language in which it was written did not seem to come from anywhere on the planet, nor from any dead language.

One of the nights of hard work trying to find out everything possible so that the damn virus did not destroy the company's computers, while he was having a coffee accompanied by a delicious bun that his wife put in his backpack every morning, he realized that all the prodigious chips, unique in the world, manufactured by the company for its own supercomputers were missing.

While he was putting the empty tupperware in which his wife put the bun in his backpack, a beam of light coming from above surrounded him. And bang! There was no more Nachete.

He appeared inside some kind of spaceship full of junk and robots, which by the looks of them, were furiously searching for something or someone.

Nachete learned something 12 years ago, and that is that he wasn't a fool anymore. He learned his lesson, so from that moment on he worked privately on a secret project which he always carries in his backpack along with the bun tupperware. This time he wasn't going to catch him off guard, finally, he could use it. The 5¼” laser rifle!!!!

Designed for situations like these, the 5¼” rifle transformed anything into high-density data.

Now, Nachete, gather the 12 PRODIGIOUS CHIPS that some evil space thing has stolen from Neurolonk and discover who or what is behind all this.

455576.overview: Track down a young girl kidnapped by a gang of thugs before it's too late, in this text adventure.  You have only 500 moves with which to find and rescue your target so make sure to think before you act!

463922.overview: You have been recruited by Dr Minestone who has discovered a new form of energy... pink tar. Your task is to mine the tar... if you can! You drive the bulldozer but watch out for the creepy crawlies! A very exciting original arcade game which requires skill and luck. Definitely a game for any arcade wizard.

463977.overview: Gobble up all the eggs in the hen house while avoiding the feathered fowl fiends who patrol their home.

467437.overview:
A long time ago, in a forgotten land, the noble knight Aldric ventured into the Twilight Castle to confront the fearsome sorcerer Zalahar. His mission was simple but dangerous: defeat the dark mage and free his kingdom from oppression. However, as he delivered the final blow, Zalahar uttered one last spell with his dying breath, and a curse wrapped Aldric in shadows.

When he awoke, Aldric discovered in horror that his body was trapped in a living suit of armor, caught between the world of the living and the realm of spirits. With no clear memories of his past or purpose, he had only one certainty: he had to escape the castle before the curse consumed him completely.

The castle, once a stronghold of power, had become a labyrinth of dark corridors, deadly traps, and shadowy creatures summoned by the warlock's magic.

Now, only one question remains: will Aldric be able to break the curse and escape the shadows before it’s too late?

Some inhabitants of the castle will mirror your movements in reverse, such as skeletons, warlocks, stone eaters, bats, and fire spirits. Others, like soldiers, move in a predefined pattern patrolling from top to bottom or left to right, independently. Ghosts are immortal and will relentlessly follow you.

To escape each room, you must defeat all the mortal enemies and obtain the key that opens the door to the next area. Once you have escaped all the rooms and proven your courage, at the final chamber, you will be able to escape the castle and reclaim your freedom.

471165.overview:
Something of a cross between SWIV and Cybernoid, Ethnipod is a maze shooter game for 1-2 players coded by Paul Angel and given away on the covertape of issue 65 of Your Sinclair magazine.

Players have three types of ammo to use adding some strategy to when you might want to utilise one of your limited acid grenades.

471845.overview:
You have journey long across blasted plains, through the ruins of old cities, and past the salt dunes, remnants of the oceans.  Now your destination is at hand.

Mutants have trailed you for many days but you have always managed to keep one step ahead of their grossly radioactive bodies.  As you neared the plains of ash, the tall ventilation shafts began to appear, the dark towers jutting from the black ash like a hand, clutching the granules of dust drifting through other, unseen drowned fingers.

As you explore, you find yourself trapped when a ledge collapses.
